The '''Gadrin Judicial Center''' was a court house in the city of [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Operated by the [[Cularin Judicial Branch]], the Judicial Center heard cases throughout the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A large building with several spires dotting its rooftop, the entrance was adorned with a statue of [[Reidi Artom]]. The [[Vultan]] [[Echari Di'San]] faced a trial at the center after he was accused of killing [[Rysko Barnt]] in a bar fight.
